description: The line plot illustrates the normalized average gate value for different expert-specialized fine-tuning approaches in sparse architectural large language models. The x-axis represents the number of experts, ranging from 1 to 64, and the y-axis represents the normalized average gate value, ranging from 0.00 to 0.20. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different fine-tuning approach: Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Math, and Code. The Intent line starts at a normalized average gate value of approximately 0.20 and decreases steadily to a value of around 0.05 at 64 experts. The Summary line starts at a value of approximately 0.15 and decreases to around 0.05 at 64 experts. The Law line starts at a value of approximately 0.10 and decreases to around 0.05 at 64 experts. The Translation line starts at a value of approximately 0.10 and decreases to around 0.05 at 64 experts. The Math line starts at a value of approximately 0.10 and decreases to around 0.05 at 64 experts. The Code line starts at a value of approximately 0.10 and decreases to around 0.05 at 64 experts. The plot also includes a gray dashed line representing the baseline, which remains constant at a value of 0.00 across all experts.
